reviewedBoundaries: Original state opened read-only under its existing exclusive lock and permanent initialization marker. Original plan, signed unknown approval and completed prefix remain unchanged.

Only original approve-usdc nonce may be cancelled: type2, same sender/self recipient, zero value/empty data/empty access list, 21000gas, exact ceil20percent fee/tip bump and bounded explicit expiry. CLI verifies EOA code, chain, fixed contracts/USDC implementation, latest and pending nonce, simulation, gas and balance before loading key.

Original and cancellation exact signed bytes/hash are independently reconciled to successful finalized canonical receipt and effect, with block hash checked twice. Unknown, nonfinal, changed/reorged effects or conflicting winners cannot admit continuation. Canonically failed winner also remains blocked.

Cancellation preparing/signed states never sign or broadcast again. State is persisted before sole send; provider/signing failure remains unresolved without retry. A pending cancellation cannot replay the original approval.

Remaining plan is fresh and bounded but preserves all token/recipient/pool/amount/route/reserve economics. It starts at original owner nonce+2 and skips completed inventory and FEE approval; original winner additionally skips USDC approval. Current allowance/balance checks precede its first sign; owner-only ETH covers all remaining fees/value/reserve.

Continuation revalidates finalized original prefix and winner on each stage, retains sequential inventory, and uses existing once journal/reconciliation. Canonically reverted mint allows only original bounded zero-approval cleanup; uncertain predecessor cannot be skipped.

Separate cancellation and remaining markers refuse missing retained state, changed binding, wrong first remaining stage and expired initial authority. Same original lock spans these derived journals. CLI errors are fixed/sanitized and signed bytes never enter public output.

reviewerFocused.scope: Existing controlled real-signature and filesystem tests only, no network or funded key; NODE_BACKEND=js TMPDIR=/private/tmp. Actual tool output recorded, not a fabricated shell log.

limits: Source approval does not guarantee mempool replacement inclusion or authorize a changed financial plan.
Exact private resolution/caps, original hash, original sender leases and fresh chain state must be checked by executing owner. No key/sign/send/network action by reviewer.
Retain original failed/broadcast-unknown evidence; winner must be finalized before a fresh remaining plan can execute.
No general reset, raw retransmission, marker deletion, arbitrary skip list or release/testnet acceptance is approved.
